select tscs.course_id courseId,count(tscs.course_id) selectedNum,ANY_VALUE(cc.name) courseName from t_csys_training_scheme_course_schedule tscs ,t_csys_course cc,t_csys_training_scheme cs where tscs.checked = 1 and tscs.course_id = cc.id and cc.sysflag =0 and tscs.sysflag = 0 and tscs.scheme_id = cs.id and cs.sysflag = 0
and cc.name like concat('%', #{courseName}, '%')
and tscs.type in
#{type}
GROUP BY tscs.course_id order by count(tscs.course_id) desc,tscs.course_id desc
select count(1) from t_csys_course tc where tc.sysflag = 0
select count(1) from t_csys_training_scheme cts where cts.sysflag = 0

select count(tcc.college_id) courseCount,tcc.college_id collectId,ANY_VALUE(sd.dept_name) collectName from t_csys_course tcc left join sys_dept sd on sd.dept_id = tcc.college_id group by tcc.college_id having count(tcc.college_id) >0

select count(ts.college_id) schemeCount,ts.college_id collectId,ANY_VALUE(sd.dept_name) collectName from t_csys_training_scheme ts left join sys_dept sd on ts.college_id = sd.dept_id group by ts.college_id having count(ts.college_id) >0

select ts.category_id categoryId,count(ts.category_id) categoryCount,ANY_VALUE(tsc.name) name from t_csys_training_scheme ts,t_csys_training_scheme_category tsc where ts.sysflag = 0 and tsc.id = ts.category_id group by ts.category_id having count(ts.category_id) >0

select cc.college_id collectId,cs.term term,count(cs.term) countTerm ,(select sd.dept_name from sys_dept sd where sd.dept_id = cc.college_id) collectName from t_csys_course cc left join t_csys_training_scheme_course_schedule cs on cc.id = cs.course_id where cc.sysflag = 0 and cs.sysflag = 0 and cc.college_id is not null group by cc.college_id,cs.term

select ku.id from t_csys_training_scheme ts inner join t_csys_training_scheme_ref_course tsrc on ts.id = tsrc.scheme_id and ts.id = #{schemeId} and ts.sysflag = 0 inner join t_csys_course_ref_ke_unit crk on tsrc.course_id = crk.course_id inner join t_csys_knowledge_unit ku on crk.unit_id = ku.id and ku.sysflag = 0
select count(id) from t_csys_course cc where cc.code = #{code} and cc.id != #{id} and cc.sysflag =0
